title: Beef Musakhan Ramekin
description: A Saudi Arabian-inspired beef musakhan recipe in a comforting ramekin dish, featuring warm spices and tender beef cutlet. Serve as a hearty dinner or meal.
instructions: Season the beef cutlet with salt, black pepper, cumin, coriander, and paprika.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned on both sides, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Transfer the beef to a plate and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the torn pita bread to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Place the beef in a ramekin and top with the pita bread mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the beef is cooked through and the pita bread is crispy.
